title: 2x Mustard Red Dragon Plug Plants – Microgreens / Salad Leaves - Hardy Mustard
description:
Mustard Red Dragon is a reliable variety producing

 dark red and green ruffled leaves

with a

 mild mustard flavour and a slight kick

. Grows up to 45cm. Suitable for salads, cooking, and especially

 microgreen production

.

 Product Details:

   Type:
  
  Mustard Red Dragon (Brassica juncea)
 

   Supplied As:
  
  2x plug plants
 

   Height:
  
  Up to 45cm
 

   Flavour:
  
  Mild mustard with some heat
 

   Uses:
  
  Microgreens, salads, stir-fries
 

 Growing Information:

   Days to Maturity:
  
  ~40
 

   Germination:
  
  7–14 days
 

   Planting Depth:
  
  ¼ inch
 

   Spacing:
  
  6 inches between plants, 18 inches between rows
 

   Light:
  
  Full sun
 

 Tips:

  Plant from early spring to autumn.
 

  Keep soil moist during germination.
 

  Harvest young outer leaves for best flavour.
 

  Sow/plant every 2–4 weeks for a steady supply.
